title.zh: Chainlink Launches CCIP 2.0 With Custom Verifiers and Faster Transfers
title.en: Chainlink Launches CCIP 2.0 With Custom Verifiers and Faster Transfers

current_state.zh: Chainlink released CCIP 2.0, adding custom verifiers and faster cross-chain transfers, with existing integrations continuing on full-finality defaults while new token-pool controls require an opt-in contract upgrade.
